headline: SSX now starts on a summit
lede: The tunnel is gone: SSX opens on a summit traverse above a ring of distant peaks, falls away down open faces with rock walls only in its gullies, and the snow is shaped — banked turns, rollers, moguls, blue-shadow hollows — with pines, rocks, fences and flags from the shared model shelf.

notes.text: #638 shipped (PR #662): painted slope IS the ridden slope — rollers, moguls and banking all live in terrainY, and the harness pins that the mesh grid equals it vertex for vertex.
A black blade in the sky cost an hour of screenshot-driven hunting: distant mesh columns stood above the near crest in silhouette. Fixed by sinking the far shoulders below the ridge line.
New gate: npm run ssxmountaincheck — 90 assertions for mountain feel, mutant-proven red (openness→1 turns 8 checks red). Old ssxcheck still 70/70.
QA filed #665: gully two-tone rock, peak silhouettes, icy near-camera wash, night/dusk heat verification, roller-launch SFX.
